Description: Sets the Farming Simulator 19 product key used to activate this machine. Found on the DVD case or in your GIANTS purchase confirmation. The same key unlocks the download at the [GIANTS eShop](https://eshop.giants-software.com/downloads.php). Activation happens automatically on first start and only needs to succeed once per Windows account. GIANTS licensing requires a separate key for each dedicated server. The game hardcodes its savegame and log folder to Documents\My Games\FarmingSimulator2019, so only one instance can run per Windows account

Sets the full URL to download the game from. Enter your product key at the [GIANTS eShop downloads page](https://eshop.giants-software.com/downloads.php), right click the Farming Simulator 19 download and copy the link address, then update the server before the link expires. The download is the full game disc image and is several gigabytes, which expands to roughly 10GB once installed
Sets the username for the dedicated server web interface

Sets the password for the dedicated server web interface. If left blank the dedicated server generates its own random password on first start, which can then be read from dedicatedServer.xml in the game installation folder
If set, the web interface is also served over TLS on the Web Interface TLS Port. Requires cert.pem and pk.pem to be present in the game installation folder, which are not shipped with the game
